Name: Tractor mod split-screen patch
Author: wwl5751
Description:
拖拉机模组分屏同步——使用指南
[heading]它的作用[/heading]
[list]
[*]按下召唤键， [b]每个本地分屏玩家都能拥有自己的拖拉机。[/b][/*]
[*]已经骑上拖拉机的玩家永远不会被赶下车或被抢走拖拉机。[/*]
[*]即使其他玩家打开了菜单，召唤功能仍然有效。[/*]
[/list][heading]要求[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]同一台电脑上的本地分屏合作游戏[/*]
[*]这些模组已安装并启用 
[code]J:\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/code]：
[list]
[*][code]TractorMod[/code] （原版拖拉机模组）[/*]
[*][code]TractorModMultiplayerSync[/code] （此补丁已部署）[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]每位玩家拥有一个拖拉机车库[/b]：每位玩家向罗宾订购自己的车库（约15万金币+材料）。拖拉机数量等于车库数量，因此每位骑手都需要建造一个车库。[/*]
[/list][heading]如何使用[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]启动游戏并加载您的分屏存档[/*]
[*]按下键盘上的召唤键（默认是 [b]退格键[/b]，或者 Tractor Mod 配置的任何按键）[/*]
[*]所有未驾驶拖拉机的玩家都会被传送到自己身边——只需骑上去即可。[/*]
[*]骑行时按下召唤键没有 [b]任何作用[/b] ——你仍然会待在你的拖拉机上。[/*]
[/list][heading]行为详情[/heading]
[list]
[*]首次召唤时，每位玩家都会被匹配到最近的未分配拖拉机；匹配结果会保存在存档文件中，因此之后你将一直使用同一辆拖拉机。[/*]
[*]使用原版下车方式（右键/动作键）下车；拖拉机会停留在你离开的地方。此补丁阻止了原版“召唤键会让你下车并将拖拉机送回家”的功能，因此误触不会导致你从拖拉机上掉下来。[/*]
[*]夜间拖拉机清理遵循原模组的规则（仅保留与车库关联的拖拉机）；过期的绑定将被清除并自动重新分配。[/*]
[/list][heading]故障排除[/heading]
[table][tr][th]症状[/th]
[th]原因/解决方法[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]日志显示 
[code]no free tractor[/code]有人什么也得不到。[/td]
[td]车库数量不足——每个玩家建造一个车库，然后再次按下召唤键。[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]按键后没有任何反应[/td]
[td]检查 SMAPI 控制台 
[code]Summon key pressed[/code]如果按键不存在，则无法识别——请在 Tractor Mod 的设置中检查按键绑定。[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]有人下马了[/td]
[td]请确保您运行的是最新补丁（自动卸载功能已被禁用）；请仅通过默认方式卸载。[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]拖拉机消失了，无法召唤。[/td]
[td]再次按下召唤键——该模组会清除无效绑定并重新分配；如果问题仍然存在，请检查车库是否被拆除。[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]检查日志[/heading]
在 SMAPI 控制台中搜索 
[code]TractorModMultiplayerSync[/code]一个正常的召唤兽看起来像这样：
[code]Summon key pressed ...
Players: 2, tractors in world: 2
xxx: assigned tractor ..., teleporting.[/code][heading]卸载[/heading]
删除 
[code]J:\Stardew Valley\Mods\TractorModMultiplayerSync\[/code] 用于恢复原始行为的文件夹。
拖拉机模组分屏连接件使用说明
Tractor Mod Split-Screen Sync — Usage Guide
[heading]What it does[/heading]
[list]
[*]One press of the summon key gives [b]every local split-screen player their own tractor[/b][/*]
[*]Players already riding are never dismounted or robbed of their tractor[/*]
[*]Summoning works even while another player has a menu open[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Local split-screen co-op on the same PC[/*]
[*]These mods installed and enabled under 
[code]J:\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/code]:
[list]
[*][code]TractorMod[/code] (the original tractor mod)[/*]
[*][code]TractorModMultiplayerSync[/code] (this patch, already deployed)[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]One tractor garage per player[/b]: each player orders their own garage from Robin (~150k gold + materials). Number of tractors = number of garages, so build one per rider.[/*]
[/list][heading]How to use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game and load your split-screen save[/*]
[*]Press the summon key on the keyboard (default [b]Backspace[/b], or whatever Tractor Mod is configured to)[/*]
[*]Every player who isn't riding gets their own tractor teleported next to them — just mount it[/*]
[*]Pressing summon while riding does [b]nothing[/b] — you stay on your tractor[/*]
[/list][heading]Behavior details[/heading]
[list]
[*]On first summon, each player is matched to the nearest unassigned tractor; the binding is saved in the save file, so you keep the same tractor afterwards[/*]
[*]Dismount with the vanilla dismount (right-click / action button); the tractor stays where you left it. The patch blocks the original "summon key dismounts you and sends the tractor home" behavior, so accidental presses can't knock you off[/*]
[*]Overnight tractor cleanup follows the original mod's rules (only garage-linked tractors persist); stale bindings are cleared and reassigned automatically[/*]
[/list][heading]Troubleshooting[/heading]
[table][tr][th]Symptom[/th]
[th]Cause / fix[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Log says 
[code]no free tractor[/code], someone gets nothing[/td]
[td]Not enough garages — build one garage per player, then press summon again[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Nothing happens on keypress[/td]
[td]Check the SMAPI console for 
[code]Summon key pressed[/code]; if absent, the key isn't recognized — verify the keybind in Tractor Mod's settings[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Someone gets dismounted[/td]
[td]Make sure you're running the latest patch (auto-dismount is blocked); dismount only via the vanilla method[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Tractor vanished and can't be summoned[/td]
[td]Press summon again — the mod clears dead bindings and reassigns; if it persists, check whether a garage was demolished[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]Checking the logs[/heading]
Search the SMAPI console for 
[code]TractorModMultiplayerSync[/code]. A healthy summon looks like:
[code]Summon key pressed ...
Players: 2, tractors in world: 2
xxx: assigned tractor ..., teleporting.[/code]
[heading]Uninstall[/heading]
Delete the 
[code]J:\Stardew Valley\Mods\TractorModMultiplayerSync\[/code] folder to restore vanilla behavior.

如果各位有模组的创意或者想要的功能可以告诉我，如果我觉得有意思可以帮忙制作
If you have any creative ideas or desired functions for modules, feel free to share them with me. If I find them interesting, I can help develop them

Manifest.Name: Tractor Mod Multiplayer Sync
Manifest.Description: When any player summons the tractor, all online teammates also get their tractor summoned. Fixes scene-change tractor loss.
